name: Atlantica Yield PLC Registered
summary: Atlantica Yield PLC (now known as Algonquin Power & Utilities Corp) is a sustainable infrastructure company that owns and manages a diversified portfolio of contracted assets in the energy and environment sectors. The company's assets include renewable energy, natural gas, electric transmission lines, and water assets located in North America, South America, and Europe. Atlantica Yield PLC is headquartered in the United Kingdom.
